#Welcome weary internet traveller
Warm yourself by the fire and take a look around

This is my maths blog!
I've been a hobbyist mathematician for a while now,
and this actually just started as a notebook of sorts,
where I would research topics and try to make them intuitive for myself.

Then I realised, why not help some others too!
It's not grad school stuff, but maybe I could help some people out.

This site is built using [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published with [Github Pages](https://docs.github.com/en/pages).
